pages.text: "I don't like cold water!" Mina backed around the water tub. The midday sun was hot, and their body sticky. With the river very low, today's wash was at the yard tub.
"I want to splash at the river!" Mina hid beneath the platform. Mom waited beside the tub with a dipper.
The space underneath was narrow and hot. Sweat dotted Mina's back, and their body itched. "I'm stickier than before." Mina scratched an arm.
Mom dipped her trunk into the tub and drew up water. Lifting it high, she blew. Water showered over the yard like rain.
Drops even splashed beneath the platform. Water felt cool on Mina's back. "Wow, real rain!" Mina peeked out.
"Want to try?" Mom tapped the tub. "Draw water into your trunk and spray it toward the sky." Round-bellied little Sonu ran over, clapping.
Mina dipped their trunk and drew up water. A blow sprayed it wide toward Sonu, who laughed. "Spray Your Trunk—Splashing Rain!" Mina drew up more.
Sticky sweat washed away. Their body cooled. Mom poured with the dipper. "Let's wash behind your ears and between your toes, too."
The next day, after water play, Mina lifted their trunk skyward again. The last drops fell. "Mom, I'm all washed!"
Mom wrapped wet Mina in a towel and hugged them. Mina gave Sonu the space. "Your turn!"
